title: Nanomaterials
definition: Nanomaterials are materials with structural features at least in one dimension falling in the nanoscale range, typically between 1 and 100 nanometers, exhibiting novel physical, chemical, and biological properties distinct from their bulk counterparts.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for Science & Technology syllabus (Prelims: direct applications, quantum dots, carbon nanotubes; Mains: GS-3 internal security, industrial manufacturing, environmental impact, ethical challenges, and indigenous technological capabilities under National Nanotechnology Mission).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Nanomaterials.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Understanding of solid-state structures and quantum mechanics principles
